title: Negative-path oracle accepts any per-case failure
evidence: Read-only in-memory module-hook injection supplied an unrelated GPU_LOST failure. All three negative tests returned successfully and printed EXPECTED REJECTION. See logs/negative-oracle-check.log.
required_action: Require distinct expected error identity/code for missing composition and invalid props; require an actual error-severity layout diagnostic for the critical-layout fixture. Add tests proving unrelated renderer failures are rejected.

title: PNG and approval metadata are written sequentially, not transactionally
evidence: Default wx guards prevent silent overwrites. Under explicit replacement, a metadata-write failure after PNG write can leave the pair inconsistent. No baseline writes were attempted in this audit.
required_action: Before high-assurance release, stage/validate the pair and provide atomic/rollback behavior for replacement. Current hash validation should fail closed on an inconsistent pair.

title: Expected font policy does not assert computed weight/style
evidence: A pure-function audit measurement with required 700 face available but computed weight 400 returned no finding. See computed-font-policy-check.json. This does not mean the actual candidates use incorrect weights.
required_action: Document this boundary and consider checking computed weight/style against the policy; availability is not proof of the specific rendered face or glyph coverage.

title: Project is untracked within a home-directory Git repository
evidence: git rev-parse --show-toplevel returns /Users/HaruMalik and scoped status is ?? ./. A clean project commit baseline cannot be established from Git.
required_action: Resolve project-local repository ownership explicitly before release; do not reset, stage or modify the enclosing repository automatically.

title: No approved baselines exist
evidence: Missing baselines must fail the visual/full gate. Candidate capture and repeat-render equality are not approval.
required_action: After fixing F1, rerun and explicitly human-review/approve the named candidates. Never auto-approve to turn the gate green.
